const items=$input.all().map(x=>x.json); const output=[]; for(const item of items){const c=item.candidate_records||[]; const qualified=c.map(candidate=>{const q=candidate.qualification||{}; const matched=q.matched_criteria||[]; const score=Math.min(100,matched.length*25+Math.min(25,Number(q.evidence_count||0)*5)+(q.has_identity?15:0)+(q.explicit_criterion_support?10:0)); const status=!q.has_identity?'needs_identity':(!q.explicit_criterion_support?'needs_evidence':(matched.length<q.requested_criteria.length?'partial_support':'qualified_for_review')); return {...candidate,qualification:{...q,qualification_score:score,qualification_status:status,automation_allowed:false,reason:status==='qualified_for_review'?'Explicit evidence supports the requested criteria; downstream compliance and human review remain required.':'Additional explicit identity/evidence is required before downstream review.'}};}); output.push({json:{...item,qualified_candidate_records:qualified,qualified_count:qualified.filter(x=>x.qualification?.qualification_status==='qualified_for_review').length,policy:'Qualification is evidence-based only. It does not determine legal distress status, equity, appraisal, seller intent, or outreach permission.'}});} return output;
